title: [AUG-100] Replace long-press progress ring with Double Ring style
why_we_need_this: The current long-press indicator on the Record button uses a single clean stroke ring. Replace it with the Double Ring style — two concentric rings filling simultaneously (outer clockwise, inner counter-clockwise) to add visual depth and distinguish the long-press feedback from other ring elements in the UI.
acceptance_criteria:
- The long-press visual on the Record button uses two concentric SVG circle rings instead of one
- Outer ring fills clockwise over 500ms
- Inner ring fills counter-clockwise over 500ms
- Both rings use the accent color (green in dark, forest green in light) with appropriate opacity differentiation (outer ~0.7, inner ~0.5)
- The existing long-press detection logic (500ms setTimeout, pointer events, longPressFiredRef guard) remains unchanged
- Dark theme ring uses #00c876 with glow filter
- Animations respect prefers-reduced-motion
- Button still scales to 0.96 during the press
